openGym.help: Connect your openGym instance so your gym workouts arrive on their own, with the exercises, sets and rests. In openGym, go to Settings → pair the mobile app, generate the code (8 letters, valid for 5 minutes) and enter it here.
openGym.result: Synced: {{created}} new, {{updated}} changed, {{deleted}} deleted · {{heart}} with heart rate · {{linked}} joined to a watch workout.
openGym.unchanged: Nothing new in openGym since last time.
openGym.matchHint: Only workouts are imported. Each new workout is matched with the heart rate imported from the watch (and calories are estimated); if the watch recorded the same session, they are joined.
openGym.useAppHelp: You already have openGym connected in Connected apps. Workouts can come through that connection, with no other code.
openGym.noAppHelp: openGym is not connected yet. Connect the app (version, updates, backups and Jarvis plans, with workouts coming through it) or connect just for workouts.
openGym.connectAppHint: In Connected apps: workouts come through this connection, and Jarvis can add plans there.
openGym.pairOnlyHint: A pairing just for Health, with the openGym code.

references.TEMPERATURE: Reference: below 37.5 °C normal · 37.5–37.9 °C low-grade fever · 38 °C or more fever.

vitals.notesPlaceholder: E.g. measured sitting, after resting 5 minutes

descriptions.bmi: Body mass index. If your scale does not give it, it is worked out from the weight and the height in your profile.
descriptions.bodyFatPct: The share of your weight that is fat, as the scale measures it.
descriptions.fatMassKg: The weight of your fat, in kg.
descriptions.subcutaneousFatPct: The fat just under the skin, as a share of your weight.
descriptions.visceralFat: The scale’s index for the fat around your organs. Lower is better.
descriptions.musclePct: Your muscles, as a share of your weight.
descriptions.muscleKg: The weight of your muscles, in kg.
descriptions.skeletalMusclePct: The muscles you move, as a share of your weight.
descriptions.skeletalMuscleKg: The weight of the muscles you move, in kg.
descriptions.bonePct: Your bones, as a share of your weight.
descriptions.boneKg: The estimated weight of your bones, in kg.
descriptions.leanKg: Everything that is not fat. If the scale does not give it, it is worked out from the weight and the fat.
descriptions.bmrKcal: The calories your body burns per day at rest (basal metabolic rate).
descriptions.waterPct: The water in your body, as a share of your weight.
descriptions.waterKg: The water in your body, in kg.
descriptions.proteinPct: The protein in your body, as a share of your weight.
descriptions.proteinKg: The protein in your body, in kg.
descriptions.waistCm: The measurement around your waist. Entered here, in Body or in a quick form.
descriptions.chestCm: The measurement around your chest. Entered here, in Body or in a quick form.
descriptions.armCm: The measurement around your arm. Entered here, in Body or in a quick form.
descriptions.thighCm: The measurement around your thigh. Entered here, in Body or in a quick form.
descriptions.hipsCm: The measurement around your hips. Entered here, in Body or in a quick form.
descriptions.neckCm: The measurement around your neck. Entered here, in Body or in a quick form.
